exposure: risk factors for severe postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 1172 patients with placenta previa who underwent cesarean section in Tongji Hospital (Wuhan, China) and 4 cooperative hospitals from January 2018 to June 2021.
finding: The four prediction models for severe postpartum hemorrhage (SPPH) in patients with placenta previa showed moderate predictive performance, with the model established by Kim JW et al. having the highest sensitivity, NPV, AUC and net benefit, and the model established by Lee JY et al. having the highest specificity, CCR and PPV.
